question: How does the speed or tempo of the music feel?
subtitle: Focus on the overall speed of the beat or pulse.
hint: Compare it to daily activities like walking, jogging, or driving.

options.label: Slow & Leisurely
options.description: Like meditative breathing, a slow dance, or a calm stroll (under 100 BPM)

options.label: Moderate & Relaxed
options.description: Like an average radio pop song or casual walking pace (100–120 BPM)

options.label: Fast & Energetic
options.description: Brisk workout pace or club dance floor speed (120–135 BPM)

options.label: Frantic & Blistering
options.description: Like a racing car engine or all-out sprint (150+ BPM)

options.label: Not Sure / Freeform
options.description: Floating without a clear pulse, or hard to tell

question: How is the drumbeat or rhythm structured?
subtitle: Listen to the kick drum and snare pattern.
hint: Notice whether the drum hits steadily on every beat, rolls in breaks, or has a dance bounce.

options.label: Steady Four-on-the-Floor
options.description: Hypnotic club thump on every single beat (thump-thump-thump-thump)

options.label: Uneven, Rolling Breakbeat
options.description: Lively, scattered drum rolls like a funk or hip-hop live drummer

options.label: Frantic Chopped Breakbeats
options.description: Rapid, stuttering drum rolls sliced up at high speed (Jungle / Drum & Bass)

options.label: Slow Head-Nod Bounce
options.description: Sluggish half-time bounce with heavy bass drops (Trap / Dubstep / Hip-Hop)

options.label: Latin Dance Bounce
options.description: Syncopated Caribbean bounce ('boom... cha-boom-cha' heard in Reggaeton)

options.label: Island Reggae Skank
options.description: Chords sharply chopping on the upbeats with a relaxed island pulse

options.label: Speeding Train Chug
options.description: Fast country two-step rhythm (chugga-chugga-chugga)

options.label: No Steady Beat
options.description: Drifting freely without drums or count (ambient soundscape or classical)

options.label: Other / Not Sure
options.description: A different rhythm or hard to pin down

question: What instruments mainly drive the sound?
subtitle: Listen to the dominant sound sources across the track.
hint: Look for synthesizers vs real amplified or wooden instruments.

options.label: Electronic Synths & Digital Beats
options.description: Produced inside computers with synthesizers, digital pads, and samplers

options.label: Amplified Electric Guitars
options.description: Loud electric guitar riffs, screaming solos, or heavy distortion amps

options.label: Acoustic Wooden Instruments
options.description: Grand piano, violins, cello, acoustic guitar, or upright bass

options.label: Horns & Brass Section
options.description: Trumpets, saxophones, or big band brass blasts

options.label: Acoustic Hand Drums
options.description: Congas, bongos, wooden log drums, or shakers (Afro / Latin percussion)

options.label: Southern Country Twang
options.description: Weeping pedal steel guitar, banjo, or country fiddle

options.label: A Blend / Not Sure
options.description: Multiple styles blended or hard to isolate

question: What do the vocals or voices sound like?
subtitle: Focus on the way the human voice is delivered.
hint: Notice whether there is singing, rapping, or if it is completely instrumental.

options.label: Purely Instrumental
options.description: No human singing or vocal performances at all

options.label: Clear Melodic Singing
options.description: Tuneful vocal melodies, pop hooks, or soulful singing

options.label: Rhythmic Rhyming / Rapping
options.description: Fast-talking spoken verses or rhyming over the beat (Hip-Hop / Rap)

options.label: Aggressive Screams / Growls
options.description: Throat-shredding screams or deep guttural monster growls (Metal / Hardcore)

options.label: Robotic / Auto-Tuned
options.description: Heavy metallic Auto-Tune snaps or vocoder robot voices

options.label: Dreamy Whispers / Floating Voices
options.description: Soft airy whispers or ghostly vocals buried deep in echo

options.label: Big Choir / Group Harmonies
options.description: Large opera or gospel choir singing rich multi-voice harmonies

options.label: Short Vocal Snippets / Not Sure
options.description: Repeated vocal chops or words without full verses

question: What does the bass sound like?
subtitle: Listen closely to the lowest frequencies.
hint: Notice if the bass is deep, buzzing, sliding, or funky.

options.label: Deep Rumbly Sub-Bass
options.description: Ultra-low rumble that shakes your chest, car, or headphones

options.label: Sliding 808 Bass Glides
options.description: Bass booms that swoop and slide smoothly up and down in pitch

options.label: Snarling Robotic Growl
options.description: Aggressive metallic chainsaw buzz or robot monster roar (Dubstep / DnB)

options.label: Rubbery Acid Squelch
options.description: Bubbling, whistling synth line that twists and shrieks (Roland TB-303)

options.label: Funky Slap Bass
options.description: Sharp thumping and popping by hitting real bass guitar strings with a thumb

options.label: Fast Galloping Bassline
options.description: Non-stop rapid 3-note machine-gun bounce behind every beat

options.label: Natural / Standard Low End
options.description: Gentle bass, acoustic upright bass, or non-dominant bass

options.label: Not Sure / In-Between
options.description: Hard to isolate the bass line

question: What distinctive sound texture or effect stands out?
subtitle: Pick any signature sound quality that defines the track.
hint: Listen to the texture of the synths, drums, or studio finish.

options.label: Heavily Distorted & Overdriven
options.description: Abrasive crunchy fuzz, factory machinery noise, or blown-out speakers

options.label: Sparkling & Ultra-Clean
options.description: Sunny commercial radio polish with bright melodies and zero grit

options.label: Euphoric Festival Anthem Chords
options.description: Thick, buzzing electronic chords swelling into an epic melody (EDM / Trance drop)

options.label: Warm, Cozy Vintage Tone
options.description: Soft rounded tones like an old 1970s vinyl record on warm living room speakers

options.label: Cavernous Repeating Echoes
options.description: Chords or drums swallowed by long delay trails bouncing into deep space

options.label: Dusty Lo-Fi Crackles & Hiss
options.description: Intentional vinyl dust crackles, cassette hiss, or muted vintage tape sound

options.label: Pounding Distorted Rave Kick
options.description: Bass drum hits with a loud punch/dong followed by a vibrating roar

options.label: Jangly Chiming Electric Guitars
options.description: Clean or slightly gritty ringing guitars typical of 90s indie/alternative rock

options.label: Gentle Spanish Nylon Guitar
options.description: Soft, warm fingerpicking on classical acoustic nylon strings

options.label: Standard / None of These
options.description: Clean standard production without these specific effects

question: What emotional mood or atmosphere dominates the music?
subtitle: Focus on the overall feeling the music creates.
hint: Consider whether the vibe is feel-good, sinister, or nostalgic.

options.label: Sunny, Joyous & Feel-Good
options.description: Bright, celebratory, and optimistic party energy that makes you smile

options.label: Dark, Moody & Menacing
options.description: Sinister, creepy, or gloomy vibe like a thriller movie or dark warehouse

options.label: Aggressive, Furious & Chaotic
options.description: High-adrenaline rage that makes you want to smash things or mosh

options.label: Nostalgic, Dreamy & Bittersweet
options.description: Sentimental longing for the past, sunset drives, or polaroid photos

options.label: Quiet, Intimate & Unplugged
options.description: Played softly and close-up, as if just for you in a quiet room

options.label: Neutral / Hard to Say
options.description: Balanced or emotionally neutral

question: How does the groove or motion make your body move?
subtitle: Notice the physical sensation of the rhythm.
hint: Notice whether it has a playful bounce or a stiff march.

options.label: Bouncy Swing or Shuffle
options.description: Loose groove with a playful skip that makes you sway side-to-side

options.label: Straight Robotic March
options.description: Rigid, steady metronome pulse marching strictly on the grid

options.label: Sudden Crushing Breakdowns
options.description: Music abruptly slams to a halt into a slow, crushing head-banging stomp

options.label: Standard / Not Sure
options.description: Standard rhythmic flow
